professionalSummary: PhD in Statistics with five years of experience leading auction‑aware ranking model development for a consumer internet company.

Expertise in setting modelling approaches, signing experiment analysis plans, reviewing peer models, running experiments under a documented analysis standard, and documenting model limitations and experiment boundaries.
experienceHighlights: Led modelling work on auction‑aware ranking models for five years, signing analysis plans adopted by ads leadership.
Set the modelling approach for three generations of auction‑aware ranking models and served as the team’s model reviewer for four other scientists.
Ran model experiments following the team’s analysis standard, with notebooks and registry entries bearing analyst name.
Authored limitation sections for each model and boundary sections for each experiment report.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Signed experiment analysis plans (registry identifiers provided).
